road.name: Glacier Creek Road (FS-39)
road.status: Closed to vehicles at mile 3 for washout repairs (as of July 2026)
road.driveNote: From Glacier, WA on SR 542, turn onto Glacier Creek Road (FS-39) toward the Heliotrope Ridge trailhead; check current Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF alerts before driving due to the active closure.
road.seasonalGate: Upper reaches typically snowed-in through winter/spring regardless of repair status

road.name: Glacier Creek Road (FR 39) to Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead
road.status: Closed to vehicles at the Glacier Creek bridge (~MP 3.0), roughly 5 miles below the trailhead, due to December 2025 flood damage. Repairs scheduled to begin after July 15, 2026, targeting reopening by late September 2026 (subject to change).
road.driveNote: Adds about 9 miles and 2,000 ft round trip on foot/bike beyond the washout.

road.name: Glacier Creek Road (FR 39) to Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead
road.status: Closed to vehicles at the Glacier Creek bridge (roughly MP 3.0, about 5 miles below the trailhead) since the December 2025 flood (repeat of a 2021 washout), for scheduled repair work through the end of October 2026; pedestrian/bike access continues at Forest Service discretion.
road.driveNote: Beyond the washout the road is walkable/bikeable only, adding about 9 miles and 2,000 ft round trip to this already-popular route.
road.seasonalGate: When intact, typically drivable late May through October.
